newsitem.title: CHILE: Salomon cuts Masisa to hold.
newsitem.headline: Salomon cuts Masisa to hold.

text.p: Salomon Brothers downgraded wood products manufacturing firm Maderas y Sintticos SA or Masisa, to hold from buy.
In a statement dated Thursday, Salomon cited poor third- quarter results and difficulty in expanding sales of medium- density fiberboard in the profitable Chilean and Argentine markets.
The report said particleboard prices were not expected to rise in 1997 and cited uncertainty over Masisa's plans to buy Infodema and a negative short-term earnings outlook.
It estimated earnings per American Depositary Receipt at 68 cents in 1996, 42 cents next year and 63 cents the following.
